about_section.title: Church of Excellence
about_section.subtitle: Welcome to Christ Embassy New Benin with Pastor Joseph Atibi-Brown. We are a vibrant local church under the global vision of Christ Embassy, dedicated to taking the divine presence of God to every life.
about_section.body: Christ Embassy is a global ministry founded by Rev. Dr. Chris Oyakhilome. At Christ Embassy New Benin, our local expression is focused on building spiritual champions through the living Word of God.

events.title: Sunday Service of Excellence
events.location: Christ Embassy New Benin Main Sanctuary
events.summary: A glorious atmosphere of celebration, uplifting praise, prophetic declarations, and deep insight from God's Word with Pastor Joseph Atibi-Brown.
events.body: The Sunday Service of Excellence is the flagship worship experience at Christ Embassy New Benin. Expect Spirit-filled praise and worship led by the Voices of Excellence Choir, revelatory teachings from God's Word, prophetic ministrations, prayer for the sick, and supernatural testimonies. Children are welcome - our Kings' Heritage Children's Church runs concurrently.

events.title: Mid-Week Service & Faith Clinic
events.location: Christ Embassy New Benin Auditorium & Online
events.summary: In-depth revelatory study into God's Word to strengthen your faith, sharpen your spirit, and empower your week with supernatural wisdom.
events.body: The Mid-Week Faith Clinic is your spiritual refueling station. Pastor Joseph Atibi-Brown and the teaching pastors break down scriptural principles with clarity and depth, equipping you to triumph over life's challenges. Interactive Bible study, prayer sessions, and personal ministry are core highlights.

events.title: Miracle Faith & Praise Night
events.time_text: First Friday of Every Month - 6:00 PM
events.summary: An extraordinary night of high praise, travailing prayer, miracles, signs and wonders, and the supernatural outpouring of the Holy Spirit.
events.body: Night of Bliss is a monthly miracle convergence where the power of God is demonstrated in healings, deliverances, and supernatural breakthroughs. Bring your sick, bring your burdens - and expect the miraculous!

events.title: An Hour With God - Friday Prayer Service
events.summary: A consecrated hour of fervent prayer, tongues, and prophetic intercession covering the church, the city, and the nations.
events.body: An Hour With God is the prayer engine of Christ Embassy New Benin. Come spend focused time in the presence of God, praying in the Holy Ghost, making prophetic declarations, and receiving divine direction for every area of your life.

events.title: 4 Nights of Advancement
events.location: Christ Embassy New Benin Main Sanctuary
events.summary: A Capacity Building Meeting - Building Champions in Christ through concentrated Word sessions, ministrations, and impartation of the Spirit.
events.body: The 4 Nights of Advancement is a special ministry conference designed to accelerate your spiritual growth, unlock supernatural abilities, and position you for greater impact in ministry, career, and life. Expect prophetic insights, powerful teachings, and divine encounters.

events.title: Foundation School Graduation
events.summary: Celebrating believers who have completed the Foundation School discipleship curriculum - a milestone of spiritual maturity and readiness for service.
events.body: Foundation School Graduation is a joyous ceremony marking the completion of our core discipleship program. Graduates receive certificates and are commissioned into active ministry service within the church. Family and friends are warmly invited to celebrate.

events.title: Praise Night with Pastor Chris
events.summary: A global atmosphere of extravagant praise and worship with Rev. Dr. Chris Oyakhilome, celebrating the faithfulness of God across the nations.
events.body: Praise Night with Pastor Chris is a global worship experience broadcast live across every LoveWorld Network. Join millions of believers worldwide in an unforgettable evening of worship, thanksgiving, and prophetic declarations.

events.title: Unending Praise Sessions
events.summary: A continuous praise and worship marathon led by rotating church groups and missions, creating an unbroken atmosphere of glory.
events.body: Unending Praise is a unique worship initiative where different church groups take turns to sustain an atmosphere of praise and worship throughout the week. Each session brings fresh fire, different worship expressions, and powerful encounters with the Holy Spirit.

featured_story.title: Supernatural Breakthrough & Divine Healing
featured_story.subtitle: "From the moment I joined Christ Embassy New Benin, God's Word completely turned my situation around. Glory to God!"

stories.title: Supernatural Breakthrough & Divine Healing from Chronic Pain
stories.subtitle: A testimony of instantaneous restoration through the ministered Word.
stories.author: Sister Blessing Idahosa
stories.summary: After five years of debilitating spinal pain and failed medical interventions, a single prophetic utterance during the Sunday Service of Excellence brought instantaneous, total healing.
stories.quote: The moment Pastor declared liberty, I felt liquid fire course through my spine. For the first time in five years, every ache vanished completely!
stories.scripture: Jeremiah 30:17 - "For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD."
stories.body:
For over five agonizing years, I suffered from severe lumbar spine compression that severely limited my mobility. Sitting for more than ten minutes caused sharp, shooting pain down both legs, and doctors informed me that surgery was my only option with a 50% success probability.

Refusing to accept a verdict of lifelong limitation, I attended the Sunday Service of Excellence with expectant faith. During the ministration of the Word by Pastor Joseph Atibi-Brown, he paused and released a prophetic word: "There is someone here suffering from spinal degeneration; the healing power of God is fixing that spine right now!"

Immediately, a sensational warmth rushed through my back like liquid fire. I stood up, bent forward, twisted side to side, and realized that every trace of pain had dissolved! Follow-up medical scans confirmed that the vertebrae had completely aligned without surgical intervention. Glory to God for His extraordinary grace at Christ Embassy New Benin!

stories.title: Financial Open Doors in the Year of Redemption
stories.subtitle: Walking in uncommon favor, global contracts, and debt cancellation.
stories.author: Brother Emmanuel Osaro
stories.summary: Facing severe business stagnation and overdue liabilities, seed-faith partnership with Rhapsody of Realities unlocked multimillion-naira contracts within seven days.
stories.quote: When you take God's kingdom as your priority, supernatural supply responds instantly. Within seven days, contracts worth millions were signed!
stories.scripture: Philippians 4:19 - "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus."
stories.body:
Earlier this year, my logistics firm experienced unprecedented financial bottlenecks. Stalled payments from institutional clients led to mounting debt, and our operations were on the verge of total shutdown.

During the Mid-Week Faith Clinic, the teaching on Kingdom Economics and Partnership ignited a bold decision in my heart. In faith, I committed our remaining operational capital into the sponsorship of Rhapsody of Realities outreaches across Edo State.

By the following Tuesday, a multinational energy company that had previously rejected our bid contacted us directly, awarding a three-year logistics partnership worth millions of naira. All liabilities were cleared within two weeks, and we even expanded our fleet. Operating under the grace of this house has made us financially impregnable!

stories.title: An Entire Family Won to Christ Through Cell Fellowship
stories.subtitle: Generational transformation sparked by a neighborhood home cell outreach.
stories.author: Deaconess Osasere Agho
stories.summary: A mother's consistent prayers and hospitality at a local cell meeting culminated in the salvation of her husband and three grown sons on a single Sunday.
stories.quote: My home used to be filled with strife. Today, our house is an altar of prayer, praise, and passionate kingdom service.
stories.scripture: Acts 16:31 - "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house."
stories.body:
For many years, I was the only believer in my household. My husband had no interest in spiritual matters, and my teenage sons were drifting into negative peer influences. Though discouraged at times, I persevered in prayer and volunteered our living room as a cell meeting venue.

The unconditional love, vibrant fellowship, and revelatory Word shared by the cell members gradually broke down skepticism. One evening during our cell prayer time, my husband walked in, fell to his knees, and surrendered his life to Christ.

The very next Sunday at the main sanctuary, all three of my sons gave their lives to Jesus and joined the Firebrand Youth Ministry. Today, our home is a joyful sanctuary of prayer and praise, actively anchoring a thriving neighborhood cell!

stories.title: Over 300 Souls Harvested at InnerCity Medical Outreach
stories.subtitle: Demonstrating Christ's love through free healthcare, feeding, and the Gospel.
stories.author: Brother Victor Edobor
stories.summary: The Medical Outreach Unit and Youth Ministry organized a massive free health camp and food drive in suburban Benin, recording over 300 salvations and miraculous healings.
stories.quote: Seeing tears of joy as families received medical treatment, hot meals, and the message of eternal life is the heartbeat of our ministry.
stories.scripture: Matthew 25:40 - "Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me."
stories.body:
Driven by the vision of our man of God, Rev. Dr. Chris Oyakhilome, to reach every soul in our catchment area, the Missions and Health Outreach team mobilized to underserved communities around New Benin.

Over two intensive days, our volunteer doctors and nurses provided free consultations, eye examinations, medication distributions, and nutritional packs to over 700 residents. More importantly, our soul-winning teams ministered the Gospel one-on-one.

Over 300 men, women, and youth made public confessions of salvation and received free copies of the Rhapsody of Realities. Multiple attendees were healed on the spot from sight defects and joint pains, proving once again that the Gospel is the power of God in action!

stories.title: From Academic Probation to First-Class Honors Degree
stories.subtitle: Supernatural intellect and wisdom activated through the Word of God.
stories.author: Sister Chidinma Okonkwo
stories.summary: Guided by pastoral counsel and confessions of faith, a university student turned around failing grades to graduate with top honors.
stories.quote: I learned from church that the Holy Spirit imparts supernatural intelligence. My mind was sharpened beyond human capability!
stories.scripture: Daniel 1:20 - "And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, the king found them ten times better."
stories.body:
In my second year studying engineering, I hit an all-time academic low. Due to severe exam anxiety, my cumulative grade point average slipped into academic warning territory, and I contemplated dropping out.

During a Teens and Youth Camp conference at Christ Embassy New Benin, our pastor taught on the mind of Christ and the wisdom of Daniel. I registered for Foundation School, began declaring God's Word over my intellect every morning, and attended weekly prayer services.

A supernatural calmness and sharpness replaced the panic. In subsequent semesters, I scored straight A's in the toughest courses, ultimately graduating with First-Class Honors! The Word works when you work it!

stories.title: Seven Years of Barrenness Broken by Prophetic Ministration
stories.subtitle: A precious baby boy born to a joyful couple after doctors declared conception impossible.
stories.author: Mr. & Mrs. Kenneth Igbinovia
stories.summary: After four failed IVF treatments and 7 years of tears, God's promise was fulfilled with the birth of baby Samuel following an impartation service.
stories.quote: Men said it was biologically impossible, but God had the final say. Our arms are full of praise today!
stories.scripture: 1 Samuel 1:27 - "For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him."
stories.body:
For seven long years, our marriage endured the emotional and financial strain of childlessness. Specialist medical consultations concluded with bilateral tubal occlusion and severe hormonal imbalances, leaving IVF as our only route — which sadly failed four consecutive times.

At our annual Miracle Faith & Praise Night, Pastor laid hands on us and declared: "By this time next year, you shall hold your covenant child!" We received that word with tears of joy and stopped looking at medical reports.

Two months later, my wife took a routine test and it was positive! The pregnancy progressed smoothly without any complications, and she gave birth to our bouncing baby boy, Samuel. Truly, there is no impossibility with our God!

stories.title: Miraculous Preservation from Fatal Highway Accident
stories.subtitle: Angelic deliverance and preservation of life along the expressway.
stories.author: Brother Festus Omoigui
stories.summary: When a vehicle suffered a high-speed tire blowout on the highway, angelic protection shielded all occupants without a single scratch.
stories.quote: The car somersaulted three times, yet we walked out without a scratch. The angels of God are on duty around this church!
stories.scripture: Psalm 91:11 - "For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways."
stories.body:
While traveling with three colleagues along the Benin-Ore expressway, our vehicle suffered a sudden double tire blowout at high speed. The car spun violently out of control, somersaulting three times before landing on its roof in the median ditch.

As the car flipped, I shouted the Name of Jesus and declared, "I cannot die by accident; Christ is my life!" Bystanders who rushed to the mangled wreckage were astonished when all four of us unbuckled our seatbelts and climbed out completely unhurt — without even a bruise!

The car was written off as a total wreck, but our lives were preserved by the supernatural shield of divine protection. I thank God for the ministry of Pastor Joseph and the protective grace in Christ Embassy New Benin!

give.title: Online Giving & Partnership
give.subtitle: Honoring God with our substance, establishing His righteousness, and expanding the Kingdom.
give.body: Your giving and partnership drive global soul-winning, community outreaches, free distribution of Rhapsody of Realities, and ministry advancement. Every seed sown produces a boundless harvest of righteousness in your life and eternal impact across nations.

scriptures.text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver. And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work.

Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
